---
title: "Problem Library"
listing:
  contents: "problems/*/index.qmd"
  type: grid
  sort: "title"
  filter-ui:
    - title
    - mechanics_concepts
    - textbook_chapters
    - categories
    - course_topics
    - problem_types
    - competencies
    - industries
    - difficulty
  fields:
    - title
    - description
    - image
    - mechanics_concepts
    - textbook_chapters
    - categories
    - course_topics
    - problem_types
    - competencies
    - industries
    - difficulty
    - status
  page-size: 12
---

Use the search box and filters to find problems by **mechanics topic, problem type,
competency, industry context, or difficulty**. Each entry is a self-contained scenario
package that can later include student prompts, instructor notes, calculations, rubrics,
and assessment variants.

```{=html}
<script>
const searchableListingFields = [
  "mechanics_concepts",
  "textbook_chapters",
  "course_topics",
  "problem_types",
  "competencies",
  "industries",
  "difficulty",
  "status",
];

const exposeListingMetadata = (root) => {
  searchableListingFields.forEach((field) => {
    const selector = `.${field}`;
    const cells = [];

    if (root instanceof Element && root.matches(selector)) {
      cells.push(root);
    }
    if (root.querySelectorAll) {
      cells.push(...root.querySelectorAll(selector));
    }

    cells.forEach((cell) => cell.classList.add(`listing-${field}`));
  });
};

// Quarto's grid template omits listing-* classes on custom metadata cells.
// Add them while the listing is parsed so List.js can index every field.
const listingMetadataObserver = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
  mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
    mutation.addedNodes.forEach((node) => {
      if (node instanceof Element) {
        exposeListingMetadata(node);
      }
    });
  });
});

listingMetadataObserver.observe(document.documentElement, {
  childList: true,
  subtree: true,
});

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  listingMetadataObserver.disconnect();
  exposeListingMetadata(document);

  const cards = document.querySelectorAll(".quarto-grid-link");

  cards.forEach((cardLink) => {
    const cardBody = cardLink.querySelector(".card-body");
    if (!cardBody || cardBody.querySelector(".packet-actions")) {
      return;
    }

    const problemHref = cardLink.getAttribute("href");
    const problemBase = problemHref.replace(/index\.html$/, "");
    const valuesTable = cardBody.querySelector(".card-other-values");
    const metadata = {};

    valuesTable?.querySelectorAll("tr").forEach((row) => {
      const cells = row.querySelectorAll("td");
      if (cells.length === 2) {
        metadata[cells[0].textContent.trim()] = cells[1].textContent.trim();
      }
    });

    const summary = document.createElement("div");
    summary.className = "card-quick-meta";
    [
      ["Difficulty", metadata.difficulty],
      ["Status", metadata.status],
    ].forEach(([label, value]) => {
      if (!value) {
        return;
      }
      const item = document.createElement("span");
      item.textContent = `${label}: ${value}`;
      summary.appendChild(item);
    });

    if (summary.children.length > 0) {
      cardBody.appendChild(summary);
    }

    const conceptValue = metadata.mechanics_concepts || metadata["mechanics concepts"];
    if (conceptValue) {
      const concepts = conceptValue
        .split(",")
        .map((concept) => concept.trim())
        .filter(Boolean)
        .slice(0, 5);

      const conceptGroup = document.createElement("div");
      conceptGroup.className = "card-concepts";
      conceptGroup.setAttribute("aria-label", "Mechanics concepts");

      concepts.forEach((concept) => {
        const tag = document.createElement("span");
        tag.className = "card-concept";
        tag.textContent = concept;
        conceptGroup.appendChild(tag);
      });

      cardBody.appendChild(conceptGroup);
    }

    const actions = document.createElement("div");
    actions.className = "packet-actions";

    [
      ["Student packet", `${problemBase}student-packet.html`],
      ["Instructor packet", `${problemBase}instructor-guide.html`],
      ["Customize", `./instructor-builder.html?problem=${encodeURIComponent(problemBase)}`],
    ].forEach(([label, href]) => {
      const button = document.createElement("button");
      button.type = "button";
      button.className = "packet-action";
      button.textContent = label;
      button.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
        window.location.href = href;
      });
      actions.appendChild(button);
    });

    cardBody.appendChild(actions);
  });
});
</script>
```
